question_or_proposition: For Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30), does the permit term described in the PERMIT ACTION passage (effective November 1, 2016; expiration October 31, 2021) govern which enforceable discharge limits and monitoring requirements apply, or does the stated expiration date together with the proposed-reissuance framing preclude or alter applicability of that permit term during FY2025?
required_context: Federal FY2025 evaluation period (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive)
Proposed reissuance of the permit identified in the PERMIT ACTION passage
notes: The nominated span gives explicit effective and expiration dates for a prior permit term and describes a proposed reissuance. Federal FY2025 falls entirely after the stated expiration date. Different readings of whether this passage establishes governing permit applicability for FY2025 would change which limits are compared (Purpose A), which monitoring requirements are evaluated (Purpose B), and what monitoring expectations apply to missing-evidence cases (Purpose C).
